notes.content:
1.  Cancelled the magic spell code system, players now can just pick and cast magic from the rune, made it easier to cast the time magic.
2.  Now players can see the MP HP value from the left hand.
3.  Solved the ranged units sliding through the map bug after the time freeze spell.
4. Updated the tutorial on the new magic system.
5. Some visual change on the night map.
6. Fixed the index control bug.

1. Added desert and forest map.
2. Improve the physics on some melee weapons.

Let there be light...in the forest.

notes.title: 1.1 Update
notes.content:
